## Summary

What engineering or research problem does this change address?

## Contract / invariant affected

Name the architecture invariant, schema, adapter boundary, or experiment assumption touched by the change.

## Evidence

List tests, fixtures, benchmarks, hardware measurements, or independent predicate checks.

## Boundary checks

- [ ] Public runtime remains independent of private Fleet credentials/state.
- [ ] Simulated data is not presented as physical measurement.
- [ ] Acceptance evidence is external to worker/model self-report where applicable.
- [ ] Documentation/contracts are updated for behavior changes.
